name: Facet
text: Choose dark mode by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps focus on the data, matching Manus’ competitive edge. The trade-off is that light mode may feel less familiar to users who prefer bright interfaces, but we prioritize clarity and liveliness—dark mode enhances contrast and reduces glare, making interactions faster and more enjoyable.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode’s glare in dim rooms isn’t the risk—users adapt. The real trade-off is that dark mode obscures visual cues in data-heavy interfaces, where light mode’s clarity wins. Settle it with a live A/B test: measure error rates and task completion time in both modes for our actual users.
